**User Story**
As Venue Staff, I want to review pending booking requests with their event details, so that I can assess whether to approve or reject them.

**Acceptance Criteria**

* Venue Staff can view a queue/list of pending requests.
* Each request displays venue, timing, attendance, facilities/layout needs, and coordinator details.
* Venue Staff can cross-check the request against venue availability and suitability info.
